senses.gloss: m. (Augustanus, Augustianus) a servant in a colonia Augustana, (perhaps identical with Curialis or Decurio; cmp. Gibbon, ed. Milm. II, 142 sq., Amer. ed.).
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 26a:9">Snh. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>יכול לומר</he> … <he>טאן וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (Ms. C. a. F. <he>יסטוון …</he> ed. <cite ref="A00296"><he>אגיסטון</he></cite>, <cite ref="A00296"><he>אגיסטין</he></cite>, corr. <cite ref="A00269"><he>אגוסטיין</he></cite>) he may say (as an excuse for tilling in the Sabbath year), I am merely an imperial servant in the estate.
